annotations.description: Share of journeys that reached the send button and then saw a blocking message or a failed wallet operation, evaluated only once at least five journeys reached the step. User declines are excluded. Open the Transfer step tab for reasons by network and wallet.

model.expr: ((count(sum by (journey) (count_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name="layerswap-frontend" | app_environment="mainnet" | label_format journey=`{{ if .event_data_journey_id }}{{ .event_data_journey_id }}{{ else }}{{ .session_attr_journey_id }}{{ end }}` | label_format swap=`{{ if .event_data_swap_id }}{{ .event_data_swap_id }}{{ else }}{{ .session_attr_swap_id }}{{ end }}` | event_name="swap_lifecycle" | event_data_step=~"transfer_blocked|wallet_action_failed|network_switch_failed|wallet_connection_failed" | event_data_outcome=~"blocked|failed" | journey!="" | keep journey [30m]))) or vector(0)) / (count(sum by (journey) (count_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name="layerswap-frontend" | app_environment="mainnet" | label_format journey=`{{ if .event_data_journey_id }}{{ .event_data_journey_id }}{{ else }}{{ .session_attr_journey_id }}{{ end }}` | label_format swap=`{{ if .event_data_swap_id }}{{ .event_data_swap_id }}{{ else }}{{ .session_attr_swap_id }}{{ end }}` | event_name="swap_lifecycle" | event_data_step="awaiting_wallet_action" | journey!="" | keep journey [30m]))) > 4)) or vector(0)
